variables.name: AGENTX_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Project key for trace ingest and eval runs
variables.provided_by: printed by the engine on boot; regenerated per install

variables.name: EDGEONE_PAGES_API_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Non-interactive CLI auth; only needed if avoiding browser login

variables.name: MEMORIES_API_KEY
variables.purpose: sk-mavi-* key covering Visual Intelligence, Search and Agents

variables.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.purpose: Only if the build itself calls AWS; prize credits do not require it

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Unlocks AgentX LLM-judge scoring; trace ingest does not need it

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Alternative judge provider for AgentX evaluations

policy.materialization: Values are supplied by John from a secret manager or the vendor console at event time. This file and .env.example never carry values. The AgentX key is the one exception in kind only: it is generated locally by the engine on boot, is not a John-owned credential, and dies with the local SQLite store.
policy.commit: .env is gitignored and never committed. .env.example and this file are safe to commit.
